sourceFacts.description: One schematic subfigure. Two tall straight vertical black conducting plates, left and right, parallel with a broad open gap; their upper and lower extents approximately align.
Two short horizontal leads: left plate extends outward to the left near mid-height; right plate extends outward to the right near the same height. Neither lead connects to another visible apparatus.
A -|q| label is outside the upper left plate; a +|q| label is outside the upper right plate. Absolute-value bars flank q. Charges have equal magnitude and opposite sign.

Six negative signs just inside the left plate and six positive signs just inside the right plate. Each plate's signs descend in one column, staggered above or between the horizontal field lines. No additional numerical charge values.

Exactly six horizontal field arrows span the plate gap, at roughly equal descending vertical intervals. Every visible arrowhead is at the left plate, so the field is directed from the positive right plate to the negative left plate. All lines are solid; no outside field lines.
Above the top field line near the center is an italic capital E with a short rightward arrow accent above it. The accent denotes a vector, not the physical leftward field direction and not E/2.
No second subfigure, instrument, battery, switch, jar, person, dielectric depiction, distance marker, force vector, axes, grid, table, named point, units, equation, or caption within this PNG.

sourceRequirements: Preserve the two plates and two outward leads.
Preserve six field arrows, all right-to-left.
Preserve six negative and six positive sign marks.
Preserve -|q| at the left and +|q| at the right.
Preserve E as vector notation with a rightward accent; do not substitute a scalar E or E/2.

modernAdditions.description: Clean deterministic line weights, equal spacing, semantic color roles and readable type are modern presentation choices, not additional source data.

The permitted repair will use renderer-supported deterministic geometry for the source's vector accent if math-label support is unavailable. This is a representation replacement of an existing source fact, not a new field arrow or new apparatus.
